verdict.rationale: The only licensing signal is a community comment: the RCLI repo is MIT-licensed, but the MetalRT inference engine is commercial. First-party docs only imply paid use: local runs need no account, while hosted Wally Cloud tracks spend via `wally account usage`. None of this states whether commercial or enterprise use of the SDK or engine needs a paid license. Missing for 10: official license/pricing documentation, explicit commercial vs. community edition terms, enterprise licensing details, first-party confirmation of the MetalRT license.
